records.key: Download ten example images of Toxoplasma vacuoles (about 40 MB) and open the first one. Their curated masks come too, in the ground_truth_masks folder, which the editor does not read. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download ten example images of Toxoplasma vacuoles (about 40 MB) and open the first one. Their curated masks come too, in the ground_truth_masks folder, which the editor does not read. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Toxoplasma रिक्तिकाओं की दस उदाहरण छवियाँ (लगभग 40 MB) डाउनलोड करें और पहली छवि खोलें। उनके क्यूरेट किए गए मास्क भी साथ आते हैं, ground_truth_masks फ़ोल्डर में, जिसे संपादक नहीं पढ़ता। पहले डाउनलोड के बाद ये कैश में रहती हैं।
